admit site watch of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 1: claim the host
  registry: record deployment f2a9 in /var/lib/paisans/registry.json, so no other deployment here takes its token, directory, interface, port, subnet or roles (monitor)
  run:
    $ set -e; umask 077; mkdir -p /var/lib/paisans; chmod 711 /var/lib/paisans; exec 9>>/var/lib/paisans/registry.lock; flock -w 60 9 || { echo 'paisans: another command holds /var/lib/paisans/registry.lock'; exit 1; }; tmp=$(mktemp /var/lib/paisans/.registry.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; src=/var/lib/paisans/registry.json; [ -f "$src" ] || src=/dev/null; awk '-v' 'id=f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01' '-v' 'token=f2a9' '-v' 'root=/srv/paisans/f2a9' '-v' 'iface=psns-f2a9' '-v' 'port=51821' '-v' 'subnet=10.44.0.0/24' '-v' 'roles=monitor' '-v' 'site=watch' '-v' 'address=10.44.0.5' '-v' 'entry="f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01":{"token":"f2a9","root":"/srv/paisans/f2a9","domain":"","site":"watch","claimed_at":"2026-10-15T12:00:00Z","interface":"psns-f2a9","listen_port":51821,"subnet":"10.44.0.0/24","address":"10.44.0.5","roles":"monitor","toolkit_version":"<release>"}' '-v' 'header={"version":1,"deployments":{' '-v' 'footer=}}' '-v' 'marker=paisans-registry-conflict ' '-v' 'unreadable=paisans-registry-unreadable' '
    $ function str(line, name,   key, i, rest) {
    $ 	key = "\"" name "\":\""
    $ 	i = index(line, key)
    $ 	if (!i) return ""
    $ 	rest = substr(line, i + length(key))
    $ 	return substr(rest, 1, index(rest, "\"") - 1)
    $ }
    $ function num(line, name,   key, i, rest) {
    $ 	key = "\"" name "\":"
    $ 	i = index(line, key)
    $ 	if (!i) return ""
    $ 	rest = substr(line, i + length(key))
    $ 	if (!match(rest, /^[0-9]+/)) return ""
    $ 	return substr(rest, 1, RLENGTH)
    $ }
    $ function hasrole(list, r) {
    $ 	return list != "" && index("," list ",", "," r ",") > 0
    $ }
    $ function ipnum(a,   p) {
    $ 	split(a, p, ".")
    $ 	return ((p[1] * 256 + p[2]) * 256 + p[3]) * 256 + p[4]
    $ }
    $ function overlaps(a, b,   pa, pb, la, lb, sa, sb) {
    $ 	if (a == "" || b == "") return 0
    $ 	split(a, pa, "/"); split(b, pb, "/")
    $ 	la = 2 ^ (32 - pa[2]); lb = 2 ^ (32 - pb[2])
    $ 	sa = ipnum(pa[1]); sa -= sa % la
    $ 	sb = ipnum(pb[1]); sb -= sb % lb
    $ 	return sa < sb + lb && sb < sa + la
    $ }
    $ NR == 1 { if ($0 != header) bad = 1; next }
    $ done { if ($0 != "") bad = 1; next }
    $ $0 == footer { done = 1; next }
    $ {
    $ 	line = $0
    $ 	sub(/,$/, "", line)
    $ 	if (line !~ /^"[^"]+":\{.*\}$/) { bad = 1; next }
    $ 	key = substr(line, 2, index(line, "\":") - 2)
    $ 	if (key == id) {
    $ 		s = str(line, "site"); a = str(line, "address")
    $ 		if ((s != "" && site != "") ? (s != site) : (a != "" && address != "" && a != address)) {
    $ 			print marker line > "/dev/stderr"
    $ 			conflict = 1
    $ 		}
    $ 		next
    $ 	}
    $ 	if (index(line, "\"token\":\"" token "\"") || index(line, "\"root\":\"" root "\"") ||
    $ 		str(line, "interface") == iface ||
    $ 		(port != "" && port != "0" && num(line, "listen_port") == port) ||
    $ 		(subnet != "" && overlaps(subnet, str(line, "subnet"))) ||
    $ 		(hasrole(roles, "gateway") && hasrole(str(line, "roles"), "gateway")) ||
    $ 		(hasrole(roles, "data") && hasrole(str(line, "roles"), "data"))) {
    $ 		print marker line > "/dev/stderr"
    $ 		conflict = 1
    $ 	}
    $ 	kept[++n] = line
    $ }
    $ END {
    $ 	if (NR > 0 && !done) bad = 1
    $ 	if (bad) { print unreadable > "/dev/stderr"; exit 4 }
    $ 	if (conflict) exit 3
    $ 	print header
    $ 	for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) print kept[i] ","
    $ 	print entry
    $ 	print footer
    $ }
    $ ' "$src" > "$tmp"; chmod 600 "$tmp"; mv "$tmp" /var/lib/paisans/registry.json

step 2: write the egress table
step 3: reload the egress table

step 4: remove ufw rule 80/tcp
  firewall: delete `ufw allow 80/tcp comment 'paisans-f2a9: public ports, HTTP'`, which site admit added and this site's roles and configuration no longer give
  run:
    $ ufw delete allow 80/tcp comment 'paisans-f2a9: public ports, HTTP'

step 5: remove ufw rule 443/tcp
  firewall: delete `ufw allow 443/tcp comment 'paisans-f2a9: public ports, HTTPS'`, which site admit added and this site's roles and configuration no longer give
  run:
    $ ufw delete allow 443/tcp comment 'paisans-f2a9: public ports, HTTPS'

step 6: remove ufw rule 443/udp
  firewall: delete `ufw allow 443/udp comment 'paisans-f2a9: public ports, HTTP/3'`, which site admit added and this site's roles and configuration no longer give
  run:
    $ ufw delete allow 443/udp comment 'paisans-f2a9: public ports, HTTP/3'

step 7: set the host's sysctls
  sysctls: /etc/sysctl.d/60-paisans.conf, applied with sysctl --system, which applies every sysctl file on the host again, then each key checked, since a file read after it could set one back
  write /etc/sysctl.d/60-paisans.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit, for every admitted deployment that needs
    | # it; paisans site evict restores each value once none does.
    | net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
  run:
    $ sysctl --system >/dev/null && { [ "$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward)" = 1 ] || { echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward is not 1 after sysctl --system: a file read after /etc/sysctl.d/60-paisans.conf sets it'; exit 1; }; }

step 8: restore net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=1024
  sysctls: no admitted deployment needs them any more; set each back to what it was before admit
  run:
    $ sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=1024 >/dev/null

step 9: record the sysctls' values before
  sysctls: /etc/paisans/sysctl.before, for site evict to restore
  write /etc/paisans/sysctl.before mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit: each value as it was before admit
    | # first changed it. paisans site evict restores them.
    | net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0

step 10: write the admission record
  record: who the deployment runs as and what you granted, which its own commands read
  write /etc/paisans/admitted.f2a9.json mode 0644:

    |   "version": 1,

    |   "site": "watch",
    |   "roles": [
    |     "monitor"
    |   ],
    |   "grants": {
